load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental electrocatalysis data with XRD matching and fixed potential interpolation
get_production_rate: convert faradaic efficiency and current density to a production rate in mol per cm squared per second
get_distance_between_formulas: compute the euclidean distance between two chemical composition strings like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5
get_boltz_energy: compute a boltzmann weighted aggregate adsorption energy from an energy distribution and cleavage energies at a given temperature
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross validation category columns to a pandas dataframe
